_comment: Golden vectors for KOReader's partial MD5. See SPEC.md §8. Every digest here was computed on 2026-09-21 by two independent implementations that agree: a verbatim LuaJIT transcription of koreader frontend/util.lua partialMD5 (vectors/samples.lua) and the Node implementation in vectors/check.mjs.

algorithm.note: Twelve offsets. The first is 0, not 256: the loop runs i = -1..10 and LuaJIT's bit.lshift masks the shift count to five bits, so lshift(1024, -2) becomes 1024 << 30, which overflows 32 bits to 0. Stop at the first offset at or past EOF; truncate the final sample rather than padding; concatenate in offset order; MD5 once; lowercase hex.

sparse._comment: Zero everywhere except a 16-byte zero-padded decimal marker of the offset at each of the twelve offsets.

arithmeticVariant._comment: NOT what KOReader computes. The first offset read as 1024>>2 = 256 instead of 0. Listed only so these digests are identifiable if they turn up in a database.
